name: Multimodal AMR Dataset
summary: 工业室内与城市室外自主移动机器人采集的多模态时序数据集。
summaryEn: A multimodal temporal dataset from an autonomous mobile robot in industrial indoor and urban outdoor settings.
scaleZh: 工业室内和城市室外采集场景
verdict: 覆盖多传感器移动机器人环境状态的开放数据
verdictEn: Open multisensor data for mobile-robot environment states
wmNote: 雷达、ToF 和激光时序可支持鲁棒空间状态估计。
wmNoteEn: Radar, ToF, and laser sequences support robust spatial-state estimation.
